A runtime permission-set save (`PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/NAME`, active or draft then publish) accepts a grant keyed by an object that does not exist, so a typo silently grants nothing. The build already refuses the same grant (`collectPermissionGrantObjectErrors`, #18202). The save door in `packages/metadata-protocol` must judge the same set: wrong things refused loudly. Not an authorization hole: nothing is granted. `domain:server`, p2.
